summary: Backend pytest: 17/18 passed (94%). Frontend: Login, Dashboard, Tables, Reports verified rendering with seeded data and live KPIs.

critical.issue: Returns 500 - ValueError 'ObjectId' not iterable. In create_user the dict is passed to insert_one WITHOUT .copy(), so Mongo adds _id (ObjectId) to the same dict that is returned -> FastAPI fails to JSON-encode. Other create_* endpoints correctly use .copy(). Fix: change `await db.users.insert_one(new_user)` to `await db.users.insert_one(new_user.copy())` (or pop _id before returning).

issues: React console warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Likely a navigate() called during render instead of useEffect.
Recharts warning: container width/height = -1 on initial render; cosmetic only, charts render after layout.

action_items: Fix POST /api/users 500 by copying dict before insert_one (or excluding _id from response).

critical_code_review_comments: create_user mutates the inserted dict and returns it -> ObjectId leak (root cause of /api/users 500). Apply same .copy() pattern used in create_table/create_snack.

No size limit on snacks list / sessions list pagination; fine for MVP scale.
@app.on_event is deprecated in FastAPI; use lifespan handlers for future-proofing.

rca of the issue: POST /api/users: server.py line ~197 `await db.users.insert_one(new_user)` -- motor mutates the dict and adds `_id: ObjectId(...)`. Subsequent `new_user.pop('password_hash')` + return triggers FastAPI's default JSON encoder which cannot serialize ObjectId. Reproduce: login as admin, POST /api/users with {name,email,password,role}. Fix: pass new_user.copy() to insert_one OR new_user.pop('_id', None) before return.
